Until now, the only way to hear about a new version of `tidycreel` was to watch
the repository on GitHub. Many of the people who use the package do not have a
GitHub account, and should not need one to know when something changes.

So there is now a mailing list:
**[tidycreel-announce](https://groups.google.com/g/tidycreel-announce)**.

## How to join

You do not need a GitHub or Google account. Either:

- send an email (any subject, any content) to
  <tidycreel-announce+subscribe@googlegroups.com>, or
- visit the [group page](https://groups.google.com/g/tidycreel-announce) and
  click **Join group**.

To leave, send an email to <tidycreel-announce+unsubscribe@googlegroups.com>.
Every message includes that address.

## What you will get

- **[CRAN]**: each new CRAN release, about every two months. Each one covers
  what changed, and whether any estimates are affected.
- **[dev]**: a monthly update on the development version, with a link to a post
  on this blog, like [this
  month's](/posts/2026-11-09-tidycreel-dev-november.html).

That's all. Only I post to the list, so it carries no discussion threads and no
questions from other members. The member list is private. If you reply to an
announcement, the reply comes to me, not the whole list.

For questions and bug reports, the [GitHub issues
page](https://github.com/chrischizinski/tidycreel/issues) is still the best
place.

If you prefer RSS, this blog has a feed for tidycreel posts only, at
<https://chrischizinski.com/blog-tidycreel.xml>.
